name: freescript
description: Create, revise, analyze, and export screenplays with FreeScript.
long_description: A free screenwriting companion with a classic typewriter preview. Format screenplay elements, revise individual scenes, analyze characters and dialogue, and export Fountain, FreeScript JSON, or print-ready HTML. This local extension can also read and save .fountain files in the folder you choose. It does not access the Mac app's internal autosave library; exchange scripts using Fountain or JSON import/export.

workspace.title: Screenplay folder
workspace.description: The folder where FreeScript can read and save .fountain files. Other folders and the Mac app's internal library are not accessed.
